description: Generate a PDF document from a template with provided data. This uses async generation with automatic polling until completion. Returns the download URL when ready. Optionally target a specific workspace with workspace_id.

filename.description: Optional filename for the generated PDF (e.g., "invoice-001.pdf")

meta.description: Optional additional metadata to store with the document

payload.description: The data to merge into the template (must match template structure)

template_id.description: The ID of the template to use for generation

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace (app) ID to generate the document in. When omitted, uses the default workspace.

name: generate_document
